problems: Elenchus cut has no column numbers (body-only throughout); closing Ordo gives a second reading, noted per entry; several Ordo digits garbled.
Epistle ad Philemonem is printed in the body (line 13687, col 172) but is in neither Elenchus nor Ordo; added as an extra entry between Titus and Hebraeos.
Leaf/page numbers are lost in many stretches; bodyCol for 2 Tim, Argumentum Actorum, 1 Pet argumentum/expositio and Philemon rest on running heads and inference.
The 12 Sectiones of Finetti's Praefatio appear in the Ordo with garbled columns (Sectio III unreadable); kept as ordo-only parts, not body-confirmed.
Jacobi: Ordo '1151' read as 1131 (title block) rather than 1133 (epistle text); ambiguity noted in the entry.
Greek flag set from heads seen, not checked page by page.
